'''Jungui''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] and largest city of [[Lycroa]], the most successful nation in [[FLLA World Cup]] history with five titles and the eighth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 9,990,000 at the [[Lycroa|Lycroan]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|thirty-fourth-largest city in the world]] by population. Jungui is the political, financial and cultural centre of [[Lycroa]] and the seat of the federal government of the [[Lycroa|Federal Republic of Lycroa]]; [[Liambra]] serves as the country's principal financial centre.

Jungui was the de jure capital of the [[Lycroa|Federal Republic of Lycroa]] throughout the 1696–1738 partition of the country, despite the city itself being under the administration of the [[State of Lycroa]] (North Lycroa) for the duration. The southern Federal Republic continued to recognise Jungui as its constitutional capital in exile, while the city of [[Huetun]] served as the de facto seat of federal government during the partition years. Jungui's restoration as the operational federal capital was a central act of the [[Lycroan reunification]] of September 1738, and the city hosted the 1744 FLLA World Cup final (see [[1744 FLLA World Cup]]) at the Estadio Federal Jungui on 4 July 1744, the closing showpiece of the first quadrennial cycle of the reunified state.
